ambient_events: A mask comes off the rack and is checked at the lining before anything else.
The kettle goes on. Somebody is coming off a shift.
Hours are totted up on the tally board and somebody is owed a half day.
A mask goes back on its peg the wrong way round and is turned round by the next person through, without comment.
description:
A mask rack. Eleven masks: bone, plate, horn, a jaw wired open, one with too many sockets.

Every one is lined with quilted rag so it won't chafe on a long shift. Beside the rack, a tally board of names against hours, a kettle, four mugs and a tin of food.
name: The Thorn Gate
